title: Structure-Aware Photovoltaic EL Anomaly Detection with Frozen DINOv2
mechanism: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 with per-patch-position prototypes of normal cells gives a structure-aware anomaly map.
adaptation: Fit position-conditioned prototypes per cell type (full, half-cut) on pool cells; use the anomaly map as an auxiliary channel or to gate low crack probabilities. Its transfer failure motivates an unseen-source test in the benchmark.
min_experiment: No training. Metric: crack pixel AUROC on F51/H36 val v house p(crack). Kill if lower than the house model.
evidence: R: AUROC 0.888, AP 0.925 on deduplicated PVEL-AD (5,143 test images) v PaDiM 0.796, PatchCore 0.791; calibration transfer to ELPV collapsed to AUROC 0.500.
prior_overlap: Frozen DINOv2-S linear probes for segmentation showed no gain; prototype anomaly scoring was not tested.
